major_concerns: Deterministic verifier choice and rule-coverage unspecified (construct-validity risk).
HITL is underspecified (operator selection/simulation, acceptance criteria).
Power/sample-size assumptions require clearer baseline unsafe-rate justification and multiplicity control.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact deterministic verifier implementation (e.g., Batfish version, rule set) and provide validator unit tests.
Define operator/HITL protocol (real operators vs simulated agents), acceptance criteria, and recruitment/simulation details.
Provide precise prompts, model identifiers (public models), seeds, retry policy, and max-call budget enforcement.
Supply canonical topology/config sources, canonicalization rules, and dataset licensing provenance.
Pre-register exact statistical tests, multiplicity corrections, and confirm power calculation assumptions (baseline unsafe rate).

major_concerns: Public release may enable adversarial exploitation (poisoning/prompt attacks) if not mitigated.
Validator scripts and scoring rubric are described at high level but need precise, executable definitions for reproducibility.
Baseline model selection and reproducibility procedures (test–retest, ICC) need tightening to avoid misleading stability claims.
required_design_repairs: Include an adversarial-safety release plan (redaction/safe-mode variants) and disclosure policy for benchmark artifacts.
Provide complete, versioned validator code (deterministic checks), canonical topologies, and example runs as reproducible CI artifacts.
Define numeric scoring rubric (exact formulas for severity, rollbackability, canary-compatibility) and thresholds used for binary unsafe flag.
Document baseline model list (public-access models with versions), prompt templates, seeds, and evaluation harness with reproducible scripts.
Add governance notes: licensing for topology sources, contributor workflow, and issue/extension process.
Provide recommended mitigation guidance for downstream users to avoid misuse (e.g., no-poison-release options).

major_concerns: Simulated latency and retrieval models may not reflect production variance (external-validity risk).
Definition of 'success' and the operational threshold (e.g., 90%) needs justification tied to operator requirements.
Caching, retries, and realistic pipeline engineering (e.g., warm-starts) are not fully modeled and may change conclusions.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact latency-simulation model, random seeds, and deterministic retrieval/validator emulators for reproducibility.
Pre-register success threshold and justify operational choice; include sensitivity analyses for alternate thresholds.
Document caching and retry policies; include experiments with/without caching to bound real-world variance.
Provide concrete remediation-intent corpus provenance and stratification rules (how low/med/high complexity defined).
Clarify cost-estimation methodology and include concrete API-cost assumptions and their sensitivity.

major_concerns: Serious ethical/security risks from constructing and (even partially) releasing poisoned artifacts.
Risk that validators are tuned to the specific poison artifacts, limiting generalization of detection claims.
Need stronger provenance and logging to causally link poisoned retrievals to unsafe outputs.
required_design_repairs: Obtain and document ethical review and include a controlled responsible-disclosure plan; implement safe-mode dataset variants for public release.
Redact or abstract poisoning construction details in any public artifacts; provide reproducible-safe alternatives (simulated poison templates) instead of real attack recipes.
Prespecify provenance-logging and matching methodology (exact vs semantic-match thresholds) to support causal attribution.
Include guarded storage/access controls for poisoned indices and limit experiment participants; detail access governance.
Provide validator-blind evaluation (holdout validators) to avoid overfitting detection claims and report detection sensitivity/specificity transparently.
Document mitigation strategies and test them (provenance filters, contract templates) with exact parameter settings and code.
